stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $635M as BTC Nears Holders' Cost Basis
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs saw about $635 million in outflows as bitcoin's price approached an estimated $81,500 average cost basis for ETF holdings, according to CryptoSlate. That level is roughly the breakeven point for many ETF investors.
stories.whyItMatters: Outflows near breakeven can signal capitulation risk and add further pressure on bitcoin's price.
whatToWatch: Daily ETF flow data in coming sessions
Whether BTC holds above or falls below the $81,500 level
questions: What is driving the outflows: macro conditions, redemptions, or rotation into other assets?
Will flows reverse if the price stabilizes above the cost basis?

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $635 million as BTC tests their holdings’ estimated $81,500 cost basis

stories.title: OCC Issues New Stablecoin Rule on Redemptions, Banks Brace for Changes
stories.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issued a new rule affecting how stablecoins are redeemed, which CryptoSlate reports could bring significant changes for banks involved in stablecoin issuance or custody. Specifics on implementation were limited in initial coverage.
stories.whyItMatters: Redemption rules from a top US bank regulator shape how safely and quickly stablecoin holders can cash out, affecting trust in the whole market.
whatToWatch: Bank compliance timelines for the new rule
How stablecoin issuers adjust redemption processes
questions: Which banks and issuers are most affected?
When does the rule take effect?

sources.title: New OCC stablecoin rule resets redemptions, and banks face big shifts

stories.title: Tether Study Compares Cost of Owning Hardware vs. Cloud AI Tokens
stories.summary: Tether published its own study comparing the cost of buying hardware, such as a laptop, against paying for cloud-based AI tokens, CryptoSlate reports. The study reportedly identifies a point where one option becomes cheaper than the other.
stories.whyItMatters: Tether has been expanding beyond stablecoins into AI and compute infrastructure, so the study signals where it sees business opportunity.
whatToWatch: Any product or investment moves from Tether tied to AI or compute
questions: What assumptions underlie Tether's cost comparison?
Is this tied to a specific Tether product launch?

sources.title: Tether’s own AI study shows when buying a laptop costs more than cloud tokens

stories.title: HSBC's RedCoin Reaches 3.3M Users, but One Rule Limits Access
stories.summary: HSBC's RedCoin has become available to 3.3 million users, but CryptoSlate reports a single strict rule is blocking some of them from using it. The exact nature of the restriction was not detailed beyond that.
stories.whyItMatters: A major global bank pushing a branded digital asset to millions of users is a notable sign of traditional finance's crypto adoption.
whatToWatch: Whether HSBC clarifies or loosens the restriction
questions: What exactly is the rule blocking users from doing?
Is RedCoin a stablecoin, a loyalty token, or something else?

sources.title: 3.3M users gain HSBC RedCoin, yet 1 strict rule blocks them

stories.title: Coinbase to Delist Yen Stablecoin Years After Crash Triggered Lawsuits
stories.summary: Coinbase plans to remove a Japanese yen-pegged stablecoin from its platform, years after the token's price crash led to investor lawsuits, according to CryptoSlate. The move comes amid broader exchange scrutiny of smaller or troubled stablecoins.
stories.whyItMatters: Delisting a depegged stablecoin affects holders' ability to trade or redeem it and reflects tightening standards for listed stablecoins.
whatToWatch: Guidance Coinbase gives to affected holders
questions: Which stablecoin specifically is being dropped?
What options do current holders have before delisting?

sources.title: Coinbase to drop this Japanese yen stablecoin years after its price crash sparked investor lawsuits

stories.title: Aave Changes USDT Borrowing Rules, Loan Costs Jump
stories.summary: DeFi lending protocol Aave altered its rules for borrowing USDT, and CryptoSlate reports borrowing costs rose sharply as a result. The change affects users who borrow the stablecoin against collateral on the platform.
stories.whyItMatters: Aave is one of the largest DeFi lending platforms, so parameter changes ripple through borrowing costs and liquidation risk across the ecosystem.
whatToWatch: Any further governance action or parameter adjustments
questions: What specifically changed in the borrowing rules?
Was this a governance vote or an emergency action?

sources.title: Aave changes USDT borrowing rules and loan costs suddenly jump

stories.summary: CryptoSlate published an explainer on AX1 Console 2.0, described as an 'agentic activities launchpad.' Specifics on its function and how it connects to crypto markets were limited in available reporting.

stories.title: UK's FCA Says Crypto Apps Using Trade-Routing Algorithms May Need Licenses
stories.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority indicated that crypto apps using algorithms to choose trade execution routes may require a license, according to CryptoSlate. The stance could pull more crypto trading apps under formal UK regulatory oversight.
stories.whyItMatters: Extending licensing to algorithmic trade-routing would widen UK regulatory reach over crypto apps beyond basic custody or exchange services.
whatToWatch: Formal FCA guidance or consultation on the issue
How crypto apps operating in the UK respond
questions: Which specific apps or features trigger the licensing requirement?
What compliance timeline would apply?

sources.title: UK’s FCA says crypto apps may need licenses when algorithms choose trade routes

stories.title: SpaceX Perpetual Futures See About $6 Billion in Trading After Earnings
stories.summary: Perpetual futures contracts tied to SpaceX saw roughly $6 billion in trading volume following an earnings event, CryptoSlate reports. These derivatives let crypto traders speculate on private company valuations without owning actual equity.
stories.whyItMatters: The volume shows growing appetite for synthetic exposure to private companies through crypto markets, raising questions about oversight of these unregistered products.
whatToWatch: Whether trading volume holds or fades
Any regulatory response to equity-linked perpetuals
questions: Which platforms list these SpaceX perpetuals?
Is there regulatory scrutiny of this product category?

sources.title: SpaceX perpetual futures traded about $6 billion after earnings

stories.title: Evernorth's $132M Funding Option Could Add XRP but Dilute Per-Share Holdings
stories.summary: Evernorth has a $132 million funding option that could be used to buy more XRP, but CryptoSlate notes exercising it would reduce the amount of XRP backing each share. The tradeoff mirrors dilution risks seen in other corporate crypto-treasury strategies.
stories.whyItMatters: It highlights the dilution risk built into crypto treasury vehicles that fund asset purchases through new share issuance.
whatToWatch: Whether Evernorth exercises the funding option
questions: What is Evernorth's broader XRP treasury strategy?
How will the market price in the dilution risk?

sources.title: Evernorth’s $132 million funding option could buy more XRP while reducing XRP per share
